may 13 Notes:


Today I took one loss of 200 and tried to find a setup later on in the day, but never got the entry I needed.
,
Market opened and we started making moves down and after 15mins into market open, es took asian lows while nq didn’t. We also had an smt on the 5min where nq formed a 2 candle rejection block and I entered off of it. We swept premarket liquidity so there was el too and it looked like a good trade, but price clearly wanted to go lower because I got stopped out instantly. I don’t think it was a bad trade, I think the problem is that I identified it as the wrong manipulation leg as price obviously wanted to manipulate lower. (Screenshot 1)
,
We got a move down to 18:00 before 10:00 where I had the perfect bottom tick market out, a 1h rb that I thought would hold because I thought we would keep the smt with es and it worked. I didn’t take it because I wanted an entry trigger, but we made a 60pt rb out of it which is very hard to trade. 10:00 opened and we started consolidating and I was looking for trades out of that 60pt 5min rb, but the stop losses were just too big and I never found a valid entry. (Screenshot 2 & 3)
,
10:00 also gave no valid setups too off of the level itself, If we entered off of the top of the 5min rb and put sl low enough to cover the ce, that would be a winning trade, but nq was showing weakness compared to es and I didn’t see anything valid enough. Even though I read price well today and we got a huge pump for the rest of the session I took a loss. It will all balance out though and my next win will cover everything and more so just keep doing what I’m doing and it will work out.
,

,

Price later hit ote of the 4h range and made a recovery looking like the raget will be all time highs again.

(Restart) Day 1 - 11/05/26 (15m RB - 1m MMBM + STDV) (Win)**

A couple days after my first trade I took a short on NQ from a 1H RB after it swept ATH and left a large wick. Looking back, it was a dumb trade after a bad day at work. There was no engineered liquidity, unrealistic targets, and no real bearish narrative behind it. Just a gamble honestly, and I avoided journaling it afterward because I was pretty disappointed I took it in the first place

Lately I’ve struggled trading NQ, so I looked at Gold instead.


On the 4H I drew Fib from the displacement low to the recent accumulation high. Price sold off during Asia after reaching CE of the NWOG around 9pm, aligning with 0.5 of the HTF range.
,


On lower timeframe, price swept equal lows into a 15m wick resting in discount, then displaced aggressively from London Open creating another RB. Price rallied toward 00:00 and formed equal highs into the KO.
,


Although the RB reacted cleanly, it lacked engineered liquidity so I didn’t take it directly. Instead I viewed it as a possible MMBM/SMR location due to reaction from LDN open, strong DOLs and low resistance liquidity overhead.
,



A 1m breaker formed from the PDA, but after checking the Fib levels I felt the breaker entry itself was too premium. Instead I placed a 5 or 6 micro limit above a more discounted 1m FVG on the breakout leg, allowing a stop below 0.79 for an original $203 of risk, offering around 1:5 RR back into the equal highs and 00:00.
,


Got a really clean fill and after some accumulation price slowly rallied toward TP. Since it was getting late and I had work early, at around 6:30am I tightened risk after a rebalance/displacement, so closed around 1:4RR. Full TP eventually hit, but I was still content with the trade because it followed my framework properly.
,
